## Email Checker
Every hour: checks UNSENT leads (once each) in PM / IB / VC / PE / Generalist / Consulting, next-to-be-sent first, by asking each company's mail server (nothing is sent).

- works -> Email Confidence = High - verified
- other format works -> Email corrected
- nothing works -> Status = Email failed check (outreach agent skips it)
- can't tell -> marked Shady, sent only from SHADY_SENDER once the sender agent sets SHADY_SENDER_READY = YES
- also re-checks guessed emails in the Daily tabs: newly verified people are added to your outreach tabs with drafts
- results logged in the **Email Check Log** tab
